title: Base case and recursive step
summary: The two-part recipe every recursive method follows.

steps.title: Two parts
steps.say: A recursive method calls itself on a smaller input until it reaches a case it can answer directly.

steps.title: Trace it
steps.say: Each call waits for the smaller one to finish, then multiplies.

steps.title: Splitting a number
steps.say: For digits: `% 10` is the last digit, `/ 10` is everything before it.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `write a method named factorial` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find write a method named factorial with Ctrl+F.
